reconsideration_triggers: No credible maintained upstream or bounded supported backport path
Repeated security fixes incompatible with native contracts
Inability to preserve canonical authorities and authorization
No viable recovery and public deployment design
required_release_evidence: Exact supported candidate and full relevant dependency inventory
Per-advisory source/input/patch and exploit regression evidence
Hosted native browser/API/Guardian/files/realtime and supported-browser compatibility
Independent-host recovery, key handling and rollback
Wider roles/exports/attachments and native payroll/business coverage
release_policy: Keep raw failed audits unchanged. Any exception requires explicit separate governance and cannot close unrelated critical gates. No production approval based on monitoring or build smoke alone.
